title: 2.3.4. Deontological Ethics (Non-Consequentialist)
content: 👋 እንኳን ወደ Part 3 የትምህርት ክላሳችን በሰላም መጡ! በዚህ ክፍል ስለ Deontological Ethics (ዲኦንቶሎጂ)፣ የ Samuel Pufendorf የግዴታ ክፍፍሎች፣ Divine Command Theory፣ Rights Theory፣ የ Immanuel Kant Categorical Imperative እና የ W.D. Ross Prima Facie Duties በጥልቀት እንመራመራለን። 📌 What is Deontology? • Deontology stems from the Greek word "deon" (duty) and is known as duty-based ethics. • Unlike Utilitarianism ("the end justifies the means"), Deontology is summarized as "the means justifies the end." • Moral rightness or wrongness depends solely on intentions, motives, and fulfillment of duty—not on consequences or results. 👉 ዲኦንቶሎጂ በግዴታ፣ በበጎ ዓላማና በሕግ አክባሪነት ላይ የተመሰረተ የሥነ-ምግባር ትምህርት ነው። የድርጊቱ መልካምነት የሚለካው ከተግባሩ በሚገኘው ውጤት ሳይሆን፣ ድርጊቱ የተፈጸመበት በጎ ዓላማና የሞራል ግዴታን በመወጣት ብቻ ነው ("መንገዱ መጨረሻውን ያጸድቃል")። --- 📜 Samuel Pufendorf’s Classification of Duties: 17th-century philosopher Samuel Pufendorf classified moral duties into three main categories: • Duties to God: Theoretical (knowing God's nature) and Practical (inward/outward worship). • Duties to Oneself: Duties of the soul (developing talents) and Duties of the body (avoiding harm/gluttony/suicide). • Duties to Others: - Absolute Duties: Avoid wronging others, treat people as equals, promote others' good. - Conditional Duties: Keeping contracts and honoring promises. 👉 ፑፈንዶርፍ ግዴታዎችን ለሦስት ይከፍላቸዋል፡ ለፈጣሪ ያለብን ግዴታ፣ ለራሳችን ያለብን ግዴታ (አእምሮንና አካልን መንከባከብ) እና ለሌሎች ያለብን ግዴታ (አለመጎዳት፣ እኩል ማየትና ቃልን ማክበር)። 💡 Fun Fact: በ Pufendorf መሠረት በልክ መበላትና መጠጣት ለራስ ያለብንን ግዴታ የመወጣት አካል ነው—ስለዚህ ከመጠን በላይ መብላት የሞራል ግዴታን መጣስ ሊሆን ይችላል!

title: 2.3.4.1. The Divine Command Theory (DCT)
content: ⛪ Core Focus: Morality Derived Solely from God's Will According to the Divine Command Theory, ethical principles are simply the commands of God. An act is morally right if willed by God, and wrong if forbidden by God. 📌 Three Main Theses of DCT: 1. Morality originates solely with God. 2. "Moral Rightness" means willed by God; "Moral Wrongness" means against God's will. 3. No further reason for action is necessary beyond divine command. 👉 በዚህ ንድፈ-ሐሳብ መሠረት የሥነ-ምግባር መነሻው ፈጣሪ ነው። አንድ ነገር ትክክል የሚሆነው ፈጣሪ ስለፈቀደው ብቻ ሲሆን፣ ስህተት የሚሆነው ደግሞ ፈጣሪ ስለከለከለው ብቻ ነው። --- ⚠️ Two Major Problems with Divine Command Theory: 1. Redundancy ("God is Good"): If "good" merely means "what God commands," saying "God is good" becomes a logically empty statement meaning "God practices what He preaches" or "God commands what He commands." 2. Arbitrariness Objection: Morality becomes arbitrary. If right and wrong depend solely on God's decree, heinous acts like rape or cruelty would automatically become "good" if God suddenly commanded them. 👉 የዚህ ቲዮሪ ዋና ድክመቶች፡ አንደኛ "እግዚአብሔር ቸር ነው" የሚለው አባባል ትርጉም አልባ ያደርገዋል፤ ሁለተኛ ደግሞ ፈጣሪ ባዘዘው ቁጥር መጥፎ ነገሮች እንኳን ሳይቀሩ አወንታዊ ሊሆኑ ስለሚችሉ ሥነ-ምግባርን መደበኛ መመሪያ የሌለው ያደርገዋል። ሞሽ ምን አስበህ ነው ከማልወጣው ውስዋስ ውስጥ የምትከተኝ? ሲጀመር ፈጣሪ/አላህ መጥፎ ነገር እንድናደርግ ያዝዘናል? በማያውቅ አንደበቴ የአላዋቂዎችን ሀሳብ ስላስተጋባሁ አምላኬ ሆይ ይቅር በለኝ !🤷‍♂️ 📝 Exam Hint: Without God, DCT leads directly to Moral Nihilism (the view that nothing is inherently required, permitted, or forbidden).

title: 2.3.4.2. Rights Theory
content: ⚖️ Core Focus: Rights and the Correlativity of Duties Rights Theory states that a "right" is a justified claim against another person's behavior. Rights and duties are legally and morally correlated—your right implies my duty not to violate it. 📌 Foundational Thinkers: • John Locke: Argued that laws of nature bestow natural rights given by God: Life, Health, Liberty, and Possessions. • Thomas Jefferson: Incorporated Locke's view into the US Declaration of Independence: Life, Liberty, and the Pursuit of Happiness. 👉 መብትና ግዴታ የተያያዙ ናቸው። ጆን ሎክና ቶማስ ጄፈርሰን እንደሚሉት የሰው ልጅ ከተፈጥሮ (ከፈጣሪ) የተሰጡ የማይገሰሱ መብቶች አሉት። --- ✨ Four Core Features of Moral Rights: 1. Natural: Inherited by human nature, not invented/created by governments. 2. Universal: Do not change from country to country or culture to culture. 3. Equal: Identical for all human beings regardless of gender, race, or disability. 4. Inalienable: Cannot be transferred, sold, or surrendered (e.g., one cannot sell oneself into slavery). 👉 ሰብአዊ መብቶች የተፈጥሮ፣ ሁለንተናዊ (የማይቀያየሩ)፣ እኩል እና ለማንም ተልከው የማይሸጡ (Inalienable) ናቸው። 📝 Exam Hint: Correlativity of Rights and Duties means if S owes $10 to Smith, Smith has a right to $10 and S has a duty to pay $10.

title: 2.3.4.3. Immanuel Kant: Good Will & Imperatives
content: 🧠 Core Focus: Duty, Reason, and the Categorical Imperative Immanuel Kant (1724–1804) is the central figure of Deontology. He argued that consequences are morally irrelevant because they are outside our full control. Morality relies on pure practical reason and intent. 📌 The Concept of Good Will: • Kant famously declared that nothing is good without qualification except a Good Will. • Talents, intelligence, and wealth are good only if guided by a good will. A good will acts purely out of duty, not out of inclination or self-interest. 👉 ካንት እንደሚያምነው በዓለም ላይ ያለ ምንም ቅድመ-ሁኔታ መልካም የሆነ ነገር "በጎ ፈቃድ" (Good Will) ብቻ ነው። እውቀትና ሀብት የሚጠቅሙት በበጎ ፈቃድ ከተመሩ ብቻ ነው። --- 🔄 Hypothetical vs. Categorical Imperatives: • Hypothetical Imperative: Conditional and desire-driven. - Example: "If you want a good job, go to college." • Categorical Imperative: Absolute, unconditional command of reason that applies to all rational beings regardless of personal desires. - Example: "You ought not to lie." 👉 ሃይፖቴቲካል ኢምፔራቲቭ በምኞት ላይ የተመሰረተ ቅድመ-ሁኔታዊ ትእዛዝ ሲሆን፣ ካቴጎሪካል ኢምፔራቲቭ ግን ያለ ምንም ቅድመ-ሁኔታ ማንኛውም ምክንያታዊ ሰው ሊከተለው የሚገባ ፍጹማዊ ሕግ ነው። --- 🏛️ Autonomy vs. Heteronomy: • Autonomy: Self-governance; acting freely according to moral laws derived by one's own reason. • Heteronomy: Acting under external influences, desires, or fear of punishment. 👉 ኦቶኖሚ ማለት በራስ አእምሮና ምክንያታዊነት ላይ ተመስርቶ በነጻነት የሞራል ሕግን መከተል ሲሆን፣ ሄቴሮኖሚ ደግሞ በውጫዊ ጫና ወይም በፍርሃት መመራት ነው።

title: Formulations & Criticisms of Kant's Imperative
content: 🏛️ Core Focus: Kant’s Universal Maxims & Moral Rigidity Kant provided three primary formulations of the Categorical Imperative: 📌 1. The Principle of Universality: > "Act only according to that maxim whereby you can at the same time will that it should become a universal law without contradiction." • Perfect Duties (Strict/Blameworthy): Avoid actions that cause logical contradictions when universalized (e.g., suicide, breaking promises, stealing). • Imperfect Duties (Praiseworthy): Duties that allow flexibility (e.g., developing talents, helping others). 👉 የመጀመሪያው መርህ፦ የምትፈጽመው ማንኛውም ድርጊት የመላው ዓለም አጠቃላይ ሕግ ቢሆን እንኳ እርስ በርሱ የሚጋጭ አለመሆኑን አረጋግጥ። --- 📌 2. Principle of Humanity as an End, Never Merely as a Means: > "Treat humanity, whether in your own person or in the person of any other, never merely as a means to an end, but always as an end." • Never exploit, use, or manipulate human beings as mere tools/instruments (e.g., slavery, prostitution, commercial exploitation). 👉 ሁለተኛው መርህ፦ ሰዎችን ለራስህ መጠቀሚያ መሳሪያ (Means) አታድርጋቸው፤ ይልቁንም ሁልጊዜ ክብር የሚገባቸው የድርጊትህ መድረሻ (End) አድርጋቸው። --- 📌 3. Principle of Autonomy (Kingdom of Ends): • Act as if you were a legislating member in a universal kingdom of rational beings. --- 🚨 Major Criticism: Moral Rigidity (The Axe-Murderer Case) • Kant's theory is criticized for being overly rigid and ignoring extreme exceptions. • Scenario: A crazed axe-murderer asks where your children are hiding. • Kant's Answer: Universalizing lying is self-contradictory, so you must never lie—even to save your children! 👉 የካንት ቲዮሪ ትልቁ ድክመት ፍጹም ደረቅ (Rigid) መሆኑ ነው። ለምሳሌ ገዳይ ሰው ልጆችህ የት እንዳሉ ቢጠይቅህ፣ ውሸት ክልክል ስለሆነ እውነት መናገር አለብህ ይላል።

title: 2.3.4.4. W.D. Ross: Prima Facie Duties
content: 🧩 Core Focus: Pluralistic Intuitionism & Balancing Duties Scottish philosopher W.D. Ross rejected both Utilitarianism and Kantian rigidity. He introduced Prima Facie Duties ("at first sight" or conditional moral duties). 📌 Prima Facie Duty vs. Actual Duty: • Prima Facie Duty: A non-absolute moral obligation that generally applies unless overridden by a stronger moral consideration. • Actual Duty: The concrete duty one is morally bound to perform after weighing all conflicting prima facie duties in a specific situation. 👉 ፕሪማ ፋሺ ማለት በመጀመሪያ እይታ አሳማኝ የሆኑ መመሪያዎች ሲሆኑ፣ አክችዋል ዲዩቲ ደግሞ ሁኔታዎችን በሙሉ አመዛዝነን በመጨረሻ የምንወስደው ትክክለኛ የሞራል ውሳኔ ነው። --- 📜 Ross’s 7 Categories of Prima Facie Duties: 1. Fidelity: Duty to keep promises, honor contracts, and avoid deception. 2. Reparation: Duty to compensate others for past wrongdoings/injuries. 3. Gratitude: Duty to thank and assist those who have helped us. 4. Justice: Duty to distribute happiness and burdens fairly based on merit. 5. Beneficence: Duty to improve the virtue, intelligence, or happiness of others. 6. Self-Improvement: Duty to foster one's own virtue, health, wisdom, and happiness. 7. Non-Maleficence: Duty not to harm others physically or psychologically (trumps other duties). 👉 ሮስ የሰውን ልጅ የሞራል ግዴታዎች በ7 ይከፍላቸዋል፡ ታማኝነት፣ ካሳ መክፈል፣ ምስጋና፣ ፍትሕ፣ በጎ አድራጎት፣ ራስን ማሻሻል እና ሰዎችን አለመጎዳት። 📝 Exam Hint: How do we know these duties? Ross states they are self-evident and known through moral intuition rather than strict mathematical proofs. 🎉 መልካም ጥናት! Part 3 ትምህርታችን በዚህ ተጠናቋል። ቀጣይ በሚኖረን ክላስ (PART 4) ይሄን ምዕራፍ እናጠናቅቃለን።ሰላም ሁኑልን🙋‍♀️!
